items.title: Advertisers Pull Meta Ads That Had Unwanted AI Glow-ups
items.excerpt: Under Meta’s new terms coming into play Oct 30, advertisers are “solely responsible” for whatever its AI creates

items.title: Meta makes advertisers solely responsible for its AI ad edits from Oct 30
items.excerpt: Agencies say Advantage+ adds sitelinks, translations and AI images to ads they never opted in. Exverus pulled live ads. Who pays when Meta's own tools err?

items.title: OpenAI Details How ChatGPT's LLM Ad Stack Selects And Serves Ads
items.excerpt: OpenAI details how the ChatGPT ad stack uses a custom LLM orchestrator to interpret multi-turn intent, run auctions, and serve sponsored placements.

items.title: Why CNN International is building for agentic ad market that barely exists yet
items.excerpt: Plenty about CNN is up in the air post the Skydance deal. CNN International’s plan to sell ads through AI agents isn’t among them.

items.title: Target's holiday push stresses affordability, exclusives and an AI assistant
items.excerpt: Target is betting on daily deals and a digital assistant to woo budget-conscious shoppers this holiday season.

items.title: AI boosts discovery but reviews still seal the deal, new research shows
items.excerpt: Consumer surveys show AI helps shoppers find gifts, but most check reviews, compare prices and review retailers' policies before buying.

items.title: Meta case study credits Nest's AI ads with 20% higher conversion rates
items.excerpt: Seven UK brands put 68% of Meta spend into video, against a 38% benchmark. The page gives no period or baseline, so how much the AI tool added remains unclear.

items.title: Google AI Overviews now hit 88% of tracked commercial keywords, Semrush finds
items.excerpt: Review keywords triggering an AI Overview jumped from 30.14% to 89.04% in 12 months. Comparison pages now share answers with Zapier, YouTube and review sites.

items.title: Google Ads Translation Tool
items.excerpt: Google Ads is now rolling out the Translation tool within the advertiser console. This allows advertisers to "Translate your campaigns to reach global customers and boost your conversions," Google wrote.

items.title: Google Merchant Center's 6 conversational attributes explained
items.excerpt: Product data feeds are becoming a key source for AI shopping tools; Merchant Center's six conversational attributes (Q&A, documentation, related products, variants) help ecommerce advertisers get products surfaced in AI Mode and Gemini.

items.title: Should your PPC landing pages change for AI Overviews?
items.excerpt: Search and Shopping ads now appear inside AI Overviews and Google has begun ads in AI Mode; as Google gives its ad systems more freedom to match queries, ads and landing pages, here is what PPC teams should prioritize.

items.title: AI videos of crying women promote GLP-1 apps to TikTok users
items.excerpt: TikTok users are being served melodramatic slideshows of crying women confessing that they hid GLP-1 injections from loved ones.
items.note: off-list: AI-generated TikTok ad creative for GLP-1 apps; Futurism original 10-19 is outside window

items.title: AI agents could buy half of all ads by 2028: News Australia
items.excerpt: AgenticAdvertising.org opens an Australian chapter with News Australia, WPP Media and PubMatic. Paul Oyama tips agents for half of the ad spend.
items.note: off-list: agentic media buying, AdCP standards body chapter

items.title: 틱톡, '서밋 코리아 2026' 개최…AI 광고·크리에이터 마케팅 전략 공개
items.excerpt: 틱톡의 국내 광고 시장 성장률이 올해 3분기 업계 평균의 1.8배를 기록했다. 글로벌 일평균 이용 시간은 93분으로 주요 광고 플랫폼 가운데 가장 길었다. 틱톡은 AI 기반 광고 제작 도구와 크리에이터 협업, 틱톡샵을 앞세워 브랜드 인지도부터 구매 전환까지 연결하는 마케팅 전략을 제시했다.틱톡은 지난 20일 서울 강남구 그랜드 인터컨티넨탈 서울 파르나스에서 국내 브랜드와 광고 대행사 관계자 등 500여 명이 참석한 가운데 '틱톡 서밋 코리아 2
items.note: off-list (KR): TikTok Symphony / Seedance 2.5 / agentic campaign infra at TikTok Summit Korea

items.title: Republican-backed PAC accused of violating Washington AI ad law
items.excerpt: Washington Senate Democrats sent a cease-and-desist to the GOP-affiliated PAC WA Wins over a mailer allegedly using an AI-manipulated image of candidate Michael Shepard without the disclosure required by a 2023 state synthetic-media law.
items.note: body via MSN syndication AA2fQBmU; possible overlap with politics section

items.title: 코바코 'AI광고 플랫폼', 불법도박 '슬롯게임'도 뚝딱…필터링 구멍
items.excerpt: 이정헌 더불어민주당 의원이 한국방송광고진흥공사(KOBACO)의 생성형 AI 광고 제작 플랫폼이 불법·유해 광고를 제대로 걸러내지 못하고 있다는 점을 지적했다. 이 의원은 22일 국회 과학기술정보방송통신위원회 국정감사에서 KOBACO의 AI 광고 창작지원 플랫폼 '아이작(AiSAC)'에 '돈 버는 슬롯게임', '슬롯머신' 등의 키워드를 입력해 불법 도박게임을 홍보하는 광고 스토리보드를 실제로 만들어 보였다.
items.note: off-list (KR): KOBACO generative-AI ad creation platform produced illegal gambling ads

items.title: "AI 기술 담겼다더니 … "  공정위, 거짓광고땐 제재
items.excerpt: 인공지능(AI) 기술을 활용하지 않았는데도 마치 AI가 적용된 것처럼 제품 광고를 해 소비자에게 혼선을 줄 경우 법적 제재를 받을 가능성이 높아졌다. 공정거래위원회가 AI 관련 거짓·기만·부당 광고를 분별하기 위한 가이드라인을 처음 제시했다. 공정위는 'AI 관련 표시·광고 가이드라인'을 마련해 다음달까지 이해관계자와 전문가들의 의견을 청취한다고 22일 밝..
items.note: off-list (KR): KFTC draft guideline on AI-washing in product ads
